earnings.title: Investor Relations
highlights: Net income of $0.7 billion; adjusted EBIT 1 of $1.2 billion, up 1% despite incremental standalone costs
Sales of $4.6 billion, reported and organic 1 sales up 2% year over year
Board declares inaugural quarterly dividend payment of $0.40 per share on the company’s common stock
Honeywell Aerospace’s Board of Directors has approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share of its common stock.
Honeywell Aerospace sales for the third quarter increased 2% on a reported and organic¹ basis year over year.

quotes.text: Honeywell Aerospace delivered results above our expectations in its first quarter as a standalone company, increasing sales and adjusted EBIT sequentially and year over year as we accelerate investments to drive greater output and better serve our customers.
quotes.by: Jim Currier, Chief Executive Officer of Honeywell Aerospace
